Package Client

Class OrderClient

java.lang.Object
ocsf.client.AbstractClient
Client.OrderClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class OrderClient extends AbstractClient
The OrderClient class manages the client-side communication with the GoNature server. It extends AbstractClient from the OCSF framework to establish network connections, wrap client requests using the Chat carrier object, and dynamically update various JavaFX UI controllers on the JavaFX Application Thread upon receiving server responses. *

This class keeps track of the lastCommand submitted to maintain contextual state for incoming generic list-based or primitive responses.

* @author GoNature Development Team
Version:
1.0

    • handleMessageFromServer

      protected void handleMessageFromServer(Object chat)
      Core handler implementation sorting asynchronous down-stream response signals incoming from the server socket. It parses response type instances, wraps presentation inside asynchronous FX platform tasks via Platform.runLater(Runnable), handles fallback defaults, and throws UI warning alert popups.
      Specified by:
      handleMessageFromServer in class AbstractClient
      Parameters:
      chat - Polymorphic packet object transmitting server updates.
